data.name: Benyamin
data.gender_notes: Benyamin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In the Quran, Benyamin is the name of one of the twelve sons of Prophet Jacob (as). He is known as the ‘son of the right hand’ or ‘son of the favored right hand’ because Jacob held him in his right hand during the prophetic blessing of his sons. The name Benyamin carries the meaning “Son of the right hand” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Benyamin usually hope their child will grow to embody son of the right hand and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Benyamin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Son of the right hand.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Benyamin total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
